jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!
Job Summary

Optimum delivers a full suite of connectivity products — Internet, TV, Phone, and Mobile — seamlessly connecting residential and business customers at home, at work, and on the go. As a Product Manager in the Self-Service Product Management team, you will be defining the product P&L, experience, and roadmap for your responsible product. This includes the ROI of the product, definition of the features and customer experience, prioritizing and making trade-offs, driving full development lifecycles and working collaboratively with a fast paced cross functional team and ensuring we deliver usable and valuable product experience to our customers.

Responsibilities

•    Be the ambassador and SME of your product, promote visibility and value of your product across the company
•    Own the product strategy and lifecycle execution for your product
•    Manage self service portfolio products including telecom equipment self installation, identity access and management, service and account management.
•    Make value driven decisions and data driven tradeoffs to bring your product experience to the next level
•    Define and monitor key metrics and user feedback to evaluate product success
•    Deliver product launch with high quality, on time and on budget.
•    Write business & product requirements, detailed user stories and acceptance criteria
•    Manage product backlog including prioritization and scope for development sprint and release planning
•    Work with cross functional teams to design, develop, and market the product to ensure successful delivery
•    Prepare product and systems demos to key stakeholders
•    Provide subject matter expertise on your product at a granular level to the development teams and to a higher level of the entire organization.
•    Manage vendor relationships as needed
•    Be very detailed oriented but also able to summarize simply and concisely.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience required, MBA or relevant master’s degree a plus

- 8+ years of product management, customer experience (CX) or product development

- Seasoned knowledge in telecom industry including broadband, video, and mobile technologies is preferred

- Strong analytical, data interpretation, problem solving and time management skill

- Well versed in digital self-service functions such as customer onboarding, equipment self installation, authentication/access management, service management, account management and offer management, with prior experience in native mobile apps and websites

- Experience with popular identity platforms such as okta, ping is a plus

- Broad fluency across product management, business development, software and hardware engineering, UX/UI, sales and Marketing

- Demonstrated proficiency in agile framework and PO responsibilities

- Demonstrated ability to facilitate communications both technical and non-technical, across functional teams

- Proven ability to manage multiple projects and initiatives and work cross-functionally and across all levels of the organization

- Exceptional interpersonal/people skills including verbal and written communications skills, including listening and presentation skills

- Experience with creating thorough project plans and experience with playbooks and repeatable executional plans

- Experience with Excel, Visio, Jira, Confluence documentational tools

-

Internal Tools  is where execution quality directly translates into customer experience and operating cost. We need a senior individual contributor who can own the strategy and outcomes for multiple products at once: someone who frames the hard problems, makes defensible trade-offs against P&L and ROI, and partners across Care, Sales, Field, and back-office to land work that moves the business.

Responsibilities

•    Create and own the product strategy and feature set for multiple products within the Internal Tools portfolio, with minimal assistance.
•    Contribute to overall B2C, and Mobile product management portfolio strategy and planning; bring an Internal Tools point of view that shapes adjacent decisions.
•    Establish and gain acceptance for prioritized scrum backlogs across your products; prioritize feature backlogs at the product level with minimal help.
•    Define audience needs and use cases to guide feature development; act as subject matter expert and customer advocate for current and future products.
•    Construct business cases, apply policy/regulatory/security/brand guidelines, and use financial drivers to influence product decisions — leaning on senior PMs where useful, working independently where you can.

•    Serve as the Agile product owner and represent Product at Agile ceremonies; anticipate effort deltas between options before commitments are made.
Communicate at the Manager and Director Level
•    Effectively communicate product vision, principles, and roadmap to Manager and Director-level stakeholders
•    Translate business logic to technical stakeholders and product/technical capability to non-technical stakeholders.
•    Use storytelling to connect product strategy to business outcomes; create presentations that move decisions forward.
•    Disagree constructively, commit to the decision, and proactively solve cross-functional problems.
•    Identify opportunities and trends — including AI, LLM-based features, and automation — and apply them as practical enablers for agent assist, decision support, workflow automation, and internal productivity.
•    Distinguish problems where AI is the right tool from problems where it is not; bring rigor to evaluation, measurement, and rollout.
•    Maintain a developing technical understanding of Internal Tools platforms and how end-to-end technological solutions are designed and impact the customer experience.
•    Develop clear product documentation i.e. requirements, design approach, acceptance criteria
•    Vet and refine requirements; proactively find gaps in plans and work with stakeholders to specify or mitigate them.
•    Inspect project assets across your products and provide feedback that improves completeness and accuracy.
•    Proactively share knowledge to level up peers and adjacent teams.

Qualifications

•    8–10 years of product management or product operations experience, including ownership of multiple products or major product areas with measurable business outcomes.

•    Experience constructing business cases, performing P&L / ROI evaluation, and managing direct product costs.
•    Strong written and verbal communication at the Manager and Director level; comfort with executive-style writing, presentations, and storytelling.
•    Solid analytics fluency: identifies the metrics that matter, extracts insights, and makes actionable recommendations.
•    Experience as a Product Owner in an agile environment, including backlog management, sprint planning, release coordination, and Agile ceremonies.
•    Ability to simplify complex problems into core issues and key actions; pivot as needed while staying grounded in the overall strategy.
Strongly Preferred
•    Experience with internal tools, agent desktops, contact center platforms, workforce platforms, or other employee-facing software.
•    Practical experience applying AI/ML, LLM-based features, or automation to real business workflows — with a clear-eyed view of where it works and where it does not.
•    Experience contributing to portfolio-level strategy and planning across multiple product areas.
•    Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; MBA or relevant Master's a plus.
Nice to Have
•    Telecom, broadband, video, or mobile industry exposure — particularly OSS/BSS, Care, Sales, or Field operations.
•    Familiarity with regulatory, policy, and operational constraints in large telecom environments.

jobs.description:

Job Summary

Optimum delivers Internet, TV, Phone, and Mobile services that keep residential and business customers connected at home, at work, and on the go. Optimum Mobile launched as Altice Mobile in 2019 and provides nationwide mobile service.

The Product Manager supports wireless acquisition experiences across Optimum Mobile’s digital and assisted channels. This role translates business priorities into clear requirements, prioritized backlog items, launch plans, and measurable outcomes for wireless plans and offers, devices and BYOD, SIM/eSIM activation, eligibility services, financing and trade-in experiences, onboarding journeys, and network partner and vendor collaboration. The Product Manager works closely with Product leadership, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Care, Legal/Compliance, Finance, Analytics, and vendor partners to improve customer conversion, operational readiness, and the end-to-end mobile acquisition experience.

Responsibilities

- Own assigned wireless acquisition initiatives across digital, retail, care, telesales, and partner channels, supporting mobile plans, promotions, device offers, BYOD experiences, SIM/eSIM activation, financing, trade-in, onboarding, and customer-facing acquisition capabilities

- Identify customer, operational, and business opportunities using acquisition funnel performance, subscriber behavior, care drivers, employee feedback, market trends, and carrier competitive analysis

- Lead requirements discovery with cross-functional subject matter experts and translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and launch documentation for wireless acquisition, activation, provisioning, billing, OSS/BSS, eligibility, and onboarding capabilities

- Support Agile product ownership responsibilities by representing Product in ceremonies, clarifying requirements, helping resolve blockers, and ensuring delivered functionality aligns with customer, operational, and business goals

- Partner with go-to-market, Care, Sales, Retail, Training, Operations, Legal/Compliance, Finance, Analytics, Engineering, network partner, and vendor teams to ensure launch readiness across wireless systems, channels, offers, devices, activation, provisioning, billing, and care operations

- Define reporting needs, track wireless KPIs, and use pre- and post-launch analytics to assess activation, conversion, subscriber behavior, Care drivers, operational performance, customer experience, and business outcomes

- Communicate product requirements, business logic, launch scope, customer impacts, and technical capabilities clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Facilitate cross-functional meetings, align stakeholders, proactively surface and help solve issues, and drive assigned initiatives to completion

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree

- 8+ years of experience in product management, product development, consulting, financial modeling, or related roles for mobile, telecom, digital, or software-based products; wireless carrier product delivery experience preferred

- 3+ years of experience with Agile product delivery, backlog management, requirements documentation, workflow mapping, and cross-functional release coordination

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain business logic, product direction, technical capabilities, and complex topics clearly

- Strong analytical skills, including the ability to use customer behavior, acquisition funnel performance, operational data, KPIs, market activity, and post-launch results to inform decisions

- Working knowledge of wireless carrier product delivery, including rate plans, offers, device lifecycle management, SIM/eSIM activation, BYOD, activation and provisioning flows, billing impacts, OSS/BSS inputs, eligibility services, fraud concepts, onboarding journeys, APIs, and customer-facing digital experiences

- Familiarity with telecom and wireless industry concepts, carrier operations, device and network partner dependencies, and the end-to-end customer acquisition lifecycle.

- Ability to translate business needs into technology requirements and technology solutions into business-ready explanations

- Demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional teams, influence priorities, manage trade-offs, and support decision-making while maintaining strong working relationships

- Ability to understand AI/GenAI concepts, limitations, and terminology and use AI-enabled tools to streamline documentation, requirements, and communication; summarize customer feedback, operational metrics, and product usage trends; identify basic patterns and opportunities; and support business case inputs

- Self-starter with strong attention to detail, customer and stakeholder empathy, and the ability to quickly understand complex subject matter

jobs.title: Manager Software Quality Engineering & Product Operations
jobs.description:
Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!
Job Summary

Optimum is seeking a Manager of Quality Engineering & Product Operations to lead a team that elevates product quality through modern Quality Engineering practices, with a strong emphasis on test automation, engineering tooling, and development-aligned delivery.

This role sits within Product Operations and bridges UAT, product quality, and software test automation across residential and business value streams - video, broadband, voice, mobile, customer applications, B2B services, and care/field experiences. The manager builds and coaches a team that reduces manual testing over time, embeds quality earlier in the development lifecycle, and partners with Product, Engineering, and Customer Operations to improve launch readiness and post-launch reliability.

The role also connects Operational Readiness Testing, UAT, Product Trials and Beta, launch readiness, and post-launch product health so quality findings translate into clear release decisions and future product improvements.

A successful candidate combines people leadership with hands-on Quality Engineering credibility: automation strategy, CI/CD-aware testing, data-driven quality decisions, and the ability to transform how teams validate and release products.

Responsibilities

• Define and execute a Quality Engineering and test automation strategy for owned product domains.
• Lead the design, build, and maintenance of automated test frameworks and tools across residential and business products.
• Partner with Engineering to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
• Establish measurable automation and pipeline Key Results (e.g., automated coverage, flaky-test rate, mean time to validate, escaped defect rate) and drive accountability.
• Use and customize developer and observability tooling to instrument test systems, monitor quality signals, and improve feedback loops for development teams.
• Drive proof-of-concepts and prototypes to evaluate automation architectures, frameworks, and tooling tradeoffs before scaling.
• Prioritize and systematically reduce technical debt in test suites, frameworks, environments, and quality tooling.
• Introduce and mature controlled release validation capabilities.
• Act as an advocate for Quality Engineering and test automation across Product Operations and partner engineering teams.
• Manage end-to-end acceptance and validation cycles across multiple value streams, shifting from purely manual UAT toward risk-based, automation-assisted Quality Engineering.
• Lead the team in defining acceptance criteria, test scenarios, exit criteria, defect triage, and go/no-go recommendations grounded in evidence.
• Ensure rigorous testing and validation processes so releases meet acceptance criteria and reliability expectations before launch.
• Partner with Product and Engineering to refine requirements, story/acceptance criteria quality, and coverage gaps using modern SDLC practices.
• Coordinate launch readiness across environments, test data, automation suites, and cross-team dependencies.
• Ensure validation covers complete customer and frontline journeys, including installation, activation, usage, support, troubleshooting, recovery, and service restoration.
• Optimize product operations and quality processes for Optimum residential and commercial services, including broadband, video, voice, mobile, customer applications, and B2B offerings.
• Collect, analyze, and act on product performance, defect, pipeline, and customer feedback data to improve quality and operational efficiency.
• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Field Operations, Care, IT, and Marketing to resolve systemic issues, drive root-cause remediation, and improve long-term service stability.
• Identify broken handoffs, unclear ownership, and outdated workflows; implement scalable process and tooling fixes across teams.
• Track product and quality KPIs/SLAs, incident trends, and automation health; lead initiatives that reduce service disruptions and defects escaping to production.
• Ensure findings from automated testing, ORT, UAT, Product Trials, Care, Field, incidents, and customer feedback have clear ownership and are incorporated into future product and operational improvements.
• Supervise a team of Quality Engineering / Product Operations professionals, providing mentorship, coaching, workload prioritization, and performance management.
• Build team capability in programming/scripting for test automation, modern test design, CI/CD practices, and product domain knowledge.
• Identify launch and operational risks early; develop mitigation strategies and escalate with clear options and data.
• Support executive-level reporting and dashboards covering automation progress, UAT/validation health, defect trends, and operational quality performance.
• Provide regular updates to stakeholders on Quality Engineering roadmap, release readiness, and strategic quality initiatives.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 8+ years in Quality Engineering, software test automation, software development, product operations, or related engineering/quality leadership roles; telecom or large-scale technology experience preferred.

- 5+ years of people management experience

- Experience managing or formally leading people, ideally including engineers, automation developers, or quality professionals

- Hands-on experience building or leading test automation frameworks and reducing reliance on manual testing.

- Working knowledge of programming or scripting used in test automation, with the ability to guide technical contributors and evaluate automation approaches.
